prompt.project_info: Create a realistic street portrait of an approved adult man standing still in a moving city crowd.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult man wearing large over-ear headphones, a textured scarf, and dark winter outerwear looks upward thoughtfully while remaining sharp against motion-blurred pedestrians.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered vertical portrait, 85mm perspective, shallow depth of field, busy city intersection, blurred people, cars, and urban architecture.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden-hour light on face and hair, natural color grading, emotional introspective mood and realistic bokeh.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 85mm f/1.8 portrait, vertical framing, sharp subject, motion blur on crowd, realistic fabric, skin, headphones, and city texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic vertical 85mm f/1.8 street portrait of an approved adult man standing still in a busy city crowd. He wears large over-ear headphones, a textured scarf, and dark winter outerwear, looking upward thoughtfully while surrounding pedestrians and traffic blur in motion. Use warm golden-hour light on his face and hair, shallow depth, natural color, realistic bokeh, and introspective mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, frozen crowd
